verse: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
story: The crowd has eaten bread on the hillside the day before, and now they ask Jesus for a sign, mentioning the manna their ancestors ate in the wilderness.

Jesus answers with the first of His great I am statements in John: I am the bread of life. Bread is what keeps you alive, and He says that He Himself is that. To come to Him and to believe in Him are one movement of trust, and the promise is that hunger and thirst will be met. He is speaking of the deep need that food and water cannot touch. Manna fed the people for a day; He gives life that lasts.
If something in you is hungry this morning, bring it to Him. He is not a snack but a meal that stays.
